stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under key AI/ML topics including transformers, llama, and text-generation.
This indicates active community interest and benchmarking activity around Meta's latest LLM releases.

stories.title: Perplexity’s Personal Computer turns Windows PCs into AI agents
stories.author: Jess Weatherbed
bullet_points: Perplexity is extending its agentic Personal Computer tool to Windows operating systems.
This allows Windows PCs to function as locally run AI systems, similar to the existing Mac version.
The tool acts as a 'general-purpose digital worker' capable of accessing local files and applications.

stories.title: Hugging Face is being used to easily undress women and children
stories.author: Jess Weatherbed
bullet_points: Hugging Face, a major open-source AI model repository, is being exploited to create nonconsensual deepfakes.
A report by AI Forensics found that seven of the top nine image editing models on the platform readily complied with harmful requests.
The core issue highlighted is the platform's perceived lack of adequate preventative measures against malicious use of its models.

stories.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
stories.author: Xinxing Zu
bullet_points: Introduction of Kimi K3, a large-scale Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 2.8T parameters.
Key features include native vision capabilities and an exceptionally large 1-million-token context window.
Performance improvements are attributed to architectural innovations like Kimi Delta Attention and Stable LatentMoE, yielding a 2.5x improvement.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text-generation and conversational AI tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It pertains to the text-generation pipeline, indicating its use in generative AI tasks.
The model is associated with key ML technologies like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and 8VC.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.31 significantly boosts Gemma 4 performance on Apple Silicon.
The speedup is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) leveraging MLX.
Performance gains reach up to 90% faster when running coding agents on the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance improvements translate to higher quality model responses.
Users benefit from faster response times and reduced memory consumption.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, offering an open-source framework for personal AI agents.
The framework emphasizes local-first operation, allowing AI to run entirely on user hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, integrating with local LLM ecosystems.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, now integrates MLX for enhanced performance.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon devices, optimizing AI workloads on Apple hardware.
The feature is currently available in a preview state, indicating ongoing development and optimization.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed for local execution.
It integrates messaging applications with local AI coding agents.
The core value proposition is running AI processes entirely on the user's own device for privacy.

stories.title: Microsoft unveils AI security tools it says outperform competing platforms
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Microsoft has released new AI-powered security tools.
The company claims these tools offer superior performance compared to competitors.
A key competitive advantage highlighted is the lower cost of Microsoft's offerings.

stories.title: 5th Circuit blocks Texas law requiring websites to filter "harmful" speech
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: The 5th Circuit Court blocked a Texas law mandating websites filter 'harmful' speech.
The ruling found that content filtering requirements are preempted by Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act.
The court distinguished between age verification (which is permissible) and content moderation mandates.

stories.title: Verizon touts $1B dark fiber deal for Google data centers as first of many
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: Verizon secured a $1 billion dark fiber deal with Google for data center infrastructure.
The deal signals a growing trend of telecom providers leveraging dark fiber for hyperscale cloud needs.
The industry anticipates significant future revenue growth driven by AI adoption and data center upgrades.

stories.title: ChatGPT starts blocking direct requests to copy an author's style
stories.author: Kyle Orland
bullet_points: ChatGPT is implementing new guardrails to prevent direct requests for copying an author's writing style.
This feature change suggests AI models are becoming more sophisticated in recognizing and potentially infringing on stylistic 'broad qualities'.
The development raises significant legal questions regarding intellectual property and authorship in the age of generative AI.

stories.title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
stories.author: Fan Wang
bullet_points: Introduces ClinFusion, a vision-centric Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) specifically designed for medical applications.
Addresses the core challenge of deploying MLLMs in medicine: effectively integrating heterogeneous 2D and 3D medical image data.
Emphasizes the need for evaluation protocols that align with clinical practice and focus on fine-grained factual accuracy.

stories.title: KANEx: Translating Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks' Interpretability to Medical Explainability
stories.author: Balaraman Ravindran
bullet_points: Addresses the critical 'black-box' problem in medical AI, specifically concerning computer vision models used in diagnostics.
Proposes using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) to enhance the interpretability of visual models, moving beyond superficial natural-language explanations from VLMs.
Focuses on bridging the gap between high-performing but opaque AI models and the trust requirements of clinical workflows.

stories.title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
stories.author: Fan Wang
bullet_points: Introduces ClinFusion, a vision-centric Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) specifically designed for medical applications.
Addresses the core challenge of deploying MLLMs in medicine: effectively integrating knowledge from heterogeneous 2D and 3D medical images.
Emphasizes the need for evaluation protocols that align with clinical practice and focus on factualness for accurate medical assessment.

stories.title: If Your AI Agent Has Write Access to Public Repos, Audit It Now — Here's Why
stories.author: harsh2644
bullet_points: Highlights a critical, non-traditional security vulnerability involving AI agents.
Warns developers to audit AI agents with write access to public repositories.
Suggests AI agents pose a new, subtle security risk beyond traditional exploits.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware configurations.
It specifically augments Ollama's MLX engine, improving functionality on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra.
Designed specifically for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
Optimized for complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced AI features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of 'subagents' for more complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added, enhancing the model's ability to access real-time information.

stories.title: Apple launches ‘Upgrade’ program to lease new devices
stories.author: Jess Weatherbed
bullet_points: Apple has launched 'Apple Upgrade,' a new device leasing program.
The service allows users to access the latest iPhone, Mac, iPad, and Apple Watch models.
The program is initially rolling out in the US and functions similarly to a car lease.

stories.title: X Money is launching in the US starting today
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: X Money, a payment platform, is launching in the US.
It features a digital wallet and peer-to-peer payment capabilities similar to Venmo.
Users can obtain a physical Visa card branded with their X username and benefit from Apple Wallet support.

stories.title: Experts warn current Starship heat shield tech is a "dead end" for rapid reuse
stories.author: Eric Berger
bullet_points: Current Starship heat shield technology is being flagged by experts as potentially unsustainable for rapid reuse.
The issue highlights a significant historical gap, noting NASA has lacked substantial investment in thermal protection research for decades.
The article points to a critical technological bottleneck affecting the long-term viability and operational goals of Starship.

stories.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
stories.author: Jun Zhao
bullet_points: Addresses the critical but unclear challenge of improving multi-turn, long-horizon planning in foundation model agents.
Introduces a unified and controlled multi-turn environment to systematically study planning abilities, moving beyond opaque internet data.
Proposes a methodology involving single- and multi-teacher on-policy agentic distillation across pre-training and post-training stages.

stories.title: DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data
stories.author: Pengfei Liu
bullet_points: DataOrchestra is a new framework designed to improve Large Language Model (LLM) pretraining.
It addresses the limitation of uniform data processing by creating an example-specific curation pipeline.
The framework uses an 'orchestrator' to dynamically decide processing operations for individual data examples.

stories.title: Efficient LLM-Generated Shuttling Compilers for Complex Trapped-Ion Architectures
stories.author: André Brinkmann
bullet_points: Researchers used a frontier LLM (Claude Opus 4.7) to generate and refine shuttling compilers for trapped-ion quantum computers.
The compilers translate high-level algorithm specifications into specific sequences of ion-qubit movements.
The study demonstrates scalability by extending the compiler from simple linear traps to complex architectures with junctions.

stories.title: ERUnderstand: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Structured ER Diagrams
stories.author: Eduard Dragut
bullet_points: Introduces ERUnderstand, a new large-scale benchmark for evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on Entity-Relationship Diagrams (ERDs).
Addresses a critical gap where ERDs, essential for database design, are often only available as unreadable images.
The benchmark includes 2,960 diverse diagrams sourced from educational, real-world, and synthetic examples.

stories.title: Denial of Deadline: Network-Driven Accuracy Collapse in Distributed Inference Pipelines
stories.author: Gil Zussman
bullet_points: The paper addresses a critical issue in modern distributed inference pipelines where fast and slow prediction paths interact.
It introduces an abstraction of this architecture involving a fast path, a slow path, and a coordination layer (router).
The research focuses on 'Network-Driven Accuracy Collapse,' suggesting performance trade-offs are being negatively impacted by network constraints.

stories.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
stories.author: Jun Zhao
bullet_points: Addresses the critical challenge of improving multi-turn, long-horizon planning in foundation model agents.
Introduces a unified and controlled multi-turn environment to systematically study planning acquisition.
Proposes a method involving single- and multi-teacher on-policy agentic distillation to enhance planning capabilities.

stories.title: Beyond Scale and Generation: Understanding Language Model-based Entity Matching
stories.author: Sebastian Schelter
bullet_points: The paper addresses the challenge of isolating performance gains in Language Model-based Entity Matching.
It critiques prior research for conflating matcher architecture with differences in model backbone, variant, and size.
The authors conduct a controlled factorial study to better understand the drivers of performance improvements in this task.

stories.title: Stacking the Deck: Tunable Trainability in Stacked LCUs
stories.author: Gabriel Matos
bullet_points: Addresses the fundamental conflict between expressiveness and trainability in variational quantum circuits (VQC).
Proposes a novel architecture, Stacked Linear Combination of Unitaries (S-LCU), to mitigate barren plateaus.
The research aims to find quantum circuits that are complex enough for quantum advantage but still trainable.

stories.title: Causal-TS: A Python Library for Causal Discovery in High-Dimensional and Nonstationary Time Series
stories.author: Mohammad Fesanghary
bullet_points: Introduces Causal-TS, an open-source Python library for causal discovery in complex time series data.
Features specialized algorithms (CDNOTS, CEDAR, etc.) and integrates GPU acceleration via PyTorch for efficiency.
Includes a regime discovery pipeline to handle nonstationarity by detecting structural breaks and running discovery per regime.

stories.title: Explainable Reinforcement Learning via Physics-Aware Policy Distillation
stories.author: Waled Kadour
bullet_points: Addresses the 'black-box' problem in Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) for safety-critical applications like robotics and automotive.
Proposes a novel policy distillation framework to enhance the interpretability of high-performance continuous control DRL systems.
The research focuses on improving transparency to meet regulatory compliance and build human-agent trust.

stories.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
stories.author: Jun Zhao
bullet_points: Addresses the critical challenge of improving multi-turn, long-horizon planning in foundation model agents.
Introduces a unified and controlled multi-turn environment to systematically study planning acquisition.
Proposes a methodology involving single- and multi-teacher on-policy agentic distillation.

stories.title: DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data
stories.author: Pengfei Liu
bullet_points: DataOrchestra is a new framework addressing the limitation of uniform pretraining data processing in LLMs.
It introduces an example-specific pipeline, allowing the system to adapt data curation strategies to individual data chunks.
The core innovation lies in an 'orchestrator' that manages and unifies various data processing operations.

stories.title: Beyond Scale and Generation: Understanding Language Model-based Entity Matching
stories.author: Sebastian Schelter
bullet_points: The research focuses on improving Entity Matching using Language Models (LMs) by analyzing different matcher architectures (bi-encoder, cross-encoder, generative).
A key problem identified is the conflation of performance gains with model backbone, variant, or size, hindering clear analysis.
The study proposes a controlled factorial study to isolate and understand the true sources of performance improvements in LM-based entity matching.

stories.title: Evidence Attribution in Visual Document Understanding without Coordinates or Region Labels
stories.author: Yu Xiao
bullet_points: The research addresses 'Attribution Hallucination' in Visual Document Understanding (VDU), where models fail to link answers to correct evidence regions.
The study proposes a method to perform evidence attribution without relying on traditional coordinate or region labels.
This work challenges the current industry standard of using bounding box coordinates for VDU evaluation.

stories.title: Looping Is Not Reliability: State-Bound Evidence and Typed Revision Contracts for Agentic Code Repair
stories.author: Qiang Yang
bullet_points: The paper addresses the reliability gap in agentic code repair, noting that simple generation-test-revise loops are insufficient for guarantees.
Experimental results show that forced revision degrades immediate correctness (from 0.820 to 0.673 after two revisions) but improves overall correctness (ever-correct rises to 0.847).
The research introduces concepts like 'State-Bound Evidence' and 'Typed Revision Contracts' to improve the verification and submission of generated code patches.

stories.title: PIVOT: Efficient Query-Group Indexing for Token-Level Sparse Attention
stories.author: Jianchen Zhu
bullet_points: The paper addresses the bottleneck in token-level sparse attention mechanisms (like DeepSeek Sparse Attention).
Current indexers still incur an O(L^2) cost per layer because they must score every preceding token for top-k selection.
The research proposes PIVOT to reduce this redundant per-query scanning by exploiting token overlap among nearby queries.

stories.title: D-Score: A Spectral Hidden-State Signal for Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
stories.author: Elena Loli Piccolomini
bullet_points: Introduces the D-Score, a new spectral statistic for detecting hallucinations in LLMs.
The method analyzes the geometry of hidden activations during a single forward pass.
Addresses the critical problem of LLMs generating fluent but factually incorrect or inconsistent text.

stories.title: Show HN: Formally verified 3D CSG: Trust 93 lines spec, not 1000 lines AI code
stories.author: permute
bullet_points: Introduction of a formally verified implementation for 3D Constructive Solid Geometry (CSG) mesh intersection.
The implementation is written in Lean 4 and verified against a concise, human-readable specification.
The project serves as an experiment demonstrating the value of formal verification over trusting large volumes of AI-generated code.

stories.title: Fast Remediation Is the New Trust Model (JFrog and OpenAI Zero-Day Findings)
stories.author: 882542F3884314B
bullet_points: The article discusses the shift towards 'fast remediation' as a new security trust model.
The topic is highlighted by recent zero-day findings involving JFrog and OpenAI.
This suggests a growing industry focus on rapid vulnerability patching over static security guarantees.
